name: [UPD] Hatch a Duck
desc:
Grow Ducks and watch them mutate into rare and unbelievable sizes! Hatch dozens of different duck mutations and see which of the rarest you can unlock!

- Buy Duck Eggs from the dealer to sell!

- Watch them hatch offline!

- Collect their egg drops and sell them to the vendor for $$$$

- Buy rarer and better duck eggs and flex on other players!
